# omarchy-eval-golden

The golden provisioning contract.

- Four instrumented goldens back the eval-lane channels:
  - `check-omarchy-eval-base-inst` — the STABLE channel golden (charly,
    autologin, the record tools, pr-apply, the harden candy, omarchy-corpus;
    the screenlocker disabled, the always-on shell unit).
  - `check-omarchy-eval-rc-inst` — the RC channel twin.
  - `check-omarchy-eval-edge-inst` — the EDGE channel twin (also the golden the
    acceptance corpus clones).
  - `check-omarchy-eval-dev-inst` — the DEV channel twin.
  Each twin clones `omarchy.omarchy-vm`, switches the channel with
  `omarchy-channel-bootstrap <ch>`, applies the pending migrations, and
  captures its own `golden` snapshot.
- The live `channel-map` probe exposes all four; the Config Oracle selects the
  golden that fits the PR's class/channel.
- Per-PR evals clone from the selected golden; per-eval add_candy carries ONLY
  the record/spice PLUGIN providers (verbs register at check-run time).
- The goldens are disposable: true. Re-provision = delete-before-recapture +
  golden-presence verification.
- The runner stops the domain after capture.
